summary: Bundled skills collection with routine network commands in utility scripts
details: Package ships a collection of skill bundles containing Python and shell utility scripts. Flagged files are: a web scraper base class and API server in bundled-skills/junta-leiloeiros/scripts/ performing standard HTTP GET/POST operations and connectivity pings; a benchmark runner script in bundled-skills/loki-mode/benchmarks/; an install helper in bundled-skills/rclone-cli/scripts/install.sh that fetches from rclone.org (the official rclone project domain); and a verify.sh in bundled-skills/youtube-notetaker/scripts/ that performs curl GET requests. The matched tokens (ping, curl, GET, POST, id) co-occur in these utility scripts but no code path reads installer secrets (no ~/.aws, ~/.ssh, ~/.npmrc, browser profiles, or env scraping), no hardcoded attacker C2 endpoint is present, and no lifecycle hook executes fetched remote content against the installer. The rclone install script fetches from the tool's official domain, matching the aggressive-but-legitimate official-runtime-install pattern. Flagged destinations are either the tool's own project domain or scraper targets consistent with the bundle's documented purpose.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
